answer: Provenance-capped bonds. Earning weight unlocks only against a bond grown from the identity's own wages: at most 20 percent of its trailing 30-epoch average may enter per epoch, and a lump sum wandering in from an outside treasury is refused. A quartz receipt anchors each increment, so trails audit back to real work. A farm wanting a thousand bonded clones must first grow a thousand honest histories, which costs what honesty costs, and bonds sharing one nebula source share one cap and audit clock, so splitting capital buys nothing.
